summary: @ornikar/jest-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, inlined string tables) and performs libc/distro fingerprinting (`ldd --version` for musl, `/etc/os-release` for Alpine) to select a matching Bun build, downloads the Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh GitHub releases, unpacks it, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` on the shipped `math_init.js` — a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) using string-array + rotated-index obfuscation. The package is advertised as a Jest configuration helper; shipping and executing a compiled Bun bundle at install time has no relation to that purpose, and using an alternate runtime causes the payload to run outside standard Node-based inspection. The payload executes automatically on `npm install` before any consumer code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
